organization.role: Canonical upstream discovery namespace for official ComfyUI repositories.
organization.policy: All current public repositories owned by Comfy-Org are eligible official upstream sources. This registry is a curated routing index, not an exhaustive allowlist. Repository authority still depends on task relevance, target version, repository status, and whether the repository contains implementation, documentation, proposals, examples, or historical material.

policy: Use the Comfy-Org organization as the canonical upstream discovery root. Curated repository entries provide high-value routing hints only; implementation details must be read from the target/current repository rather than copied into this registry. Optional status, superseded_by, specialist, and authority_notes fields may be updated only by explicitly invoked self-maintenance or by the developer.

Official code-search client for ComfyUI/custom-node/community code. Optional accelerator.
Current official Comfy Desktop application. Use for desktop installation, environment, update, snapshot, migration and app-specific behavior.
Official examples, including application/API workflow examples.
Kernel library used for diffusion inference/performance work.
Official MCP integration and useful live-workflow validation/discovery patterns.
Official utility scripts for packaging and converting models for ComfyUI.
Community/upstream PR testing and integration context.
Official Python client SDK.
Official QA environment/tooling infrastructure.
Official offline quantization toolkit for producing ComfyUI-loadable model checkpoints.
Official Comfy Cloud agent plugin repository. Inspect the current README; its historical flat skills directory is legacy/frozen and is not the current comfy-cli skill source.
Official Swift client SDK.
Official TypeScript client SDK.
Continuous integration result dashboard and compatibility signal.
Primary runtime, execution engine, server, bundled nodes, APIs and backend implementation.
Official benchmark extension and performance measurement reference.
Official Manager implementation for custom-node lifecycle and ecosystem integration.
Official React/TypeScript frontend extension template. Use as a current implementation/scaffolding example, then verify hooks/types against ComfyUI_frontend.
Official workflow-oriented ComfyUI test framework and CI runner.
Official developer/debugging custom-node tools.
Official ComfyUI frontend implementation and frontend extension APIs/patterns.
Official custom-node extension scaffold and packaging reference.
Education/community case-study workflows and assets.
Collaborative custom-node QA workflows and validation tooling.

repositories.authority_notes: The official repository README states that LiteGraph was merged into ComfyUI_frontend. Use ComfyUI_frontend for current implementation; use this repository only when a historical compatibility target requires it.

repositories.role: Official Python extension-isolation library. Consult when extension/custom-node dependency conflicts, isolated environments, RPC boundaries, sandboxing, or tensor sharing across isolated processes are relevant.
Comfy Registry and CI dashboard backend implementation.
RFCs for substantial changes to core, APIs or standards. Proposal evidence only until implemented.
Official subgraph blueprint source/reference.
Official workflow-template source and packaging pipeline.
Official-org workflow collection. Reference patterns, not schema authority.

routing_policy.superseded_rule: For current-upstream work, follow superseded_by. For pinned or historical targets, the older source may still be relevant.
routing_policy.specialist_rule: specialist is an optional hint to an existing skill. Self-maintenance may not create new specialist skills.
